meta.purpose: Claim-level provenance for formula-spec.md. check_citation_exists.py verifies a bib entry RESOLVES; this registry verifies the source actually SAYS what the spec attributes to it. The audit3 F1/F2/F3/F5 defects all pass a DOI check and fail this one.
meta.mechanism: Each claim pins source file + PDF page + a VERBATIM quote. The verifier builds a page -> line-range map from the 'N of M' PDF footer markers in the extracted text, then requires the quote inside that page's range. Page locator and quote are independent, so a mis-transcribed quote cannot silently pass by matching itself.
meta.source_convention: Page numbers are PDF footer numbers ('9 of 33'), not printed page numbers. Quotes are copied character-for-character from the .txt extraction, INCLUDING its hyphenation and dropped-subscript artifacts ('mar-\ngin', '( )'). Do not 'clean up' a quote to match the spec's LaTeX rendering: that reconstruction is the exact defect class this gate exists to catch.
meta.extraction_line_split: split('\n') only. The .txt files contain 33 (Kim) / 17 (Song) / 13 (GF-3) form-feed page separators, which str.splitlines() also breaks on, shifting every line number after page 1.
meta.source_availability: literature/ is gitignored (.gitignore:13). A fresh clone cannot verify any claim; the verifier returns exit 2, never 0, in that case.
meta.registration_policy: Register a claim when it is (a) a load-bearing formula attribution, (b) a numeric anchor entering a fixture or test expectation, or (c) a conflict/errata record. Coverage grows as tickets 21 and 17 touch their sections; it is not meant to cover every p.N mention in the spec. Extending this file is expected, not exceptional.
meta.initial_scope: audit3 F1/F2/F3/F5 plus the two spot-checked formula attributions (GF-3 Eq.(2), Kim Eq.(12)/(13) bridge). F3 and F5 are registered as explicit KNOWN-BROKEN entries so the gate reports the real current state rather than a curated green.

claims.summary: formula-spec.md:107 quotes Kim p.9's Eq.(12)/(13) bridge sentence; the 'pymupdf 逐字抽取' label is CONFIRMED accurate
claims.note: RESOLVED 2026-10-02 by extracting the PDF directly with pymupdf (fitz 1.27.2.3), page index 8. pymupdf yields the bridge sentence with its structure intact but its glyphs as mojibake, e.g. 'ටోඬమା౞మ(௧ି௧బ)మ= sin ቀ𝜓௦బ+ ... ఏౌశቁ and ... = sin ቀ𝜓௦భ− ఏౌశቁ, Equation (12) can be expressed simply as Equation (13).' That is exactly the structure the spec renders as Vs(t-t0)/sqrt(R0^2+Vs^2(t-t0)^2)=sin(psi_s0+theta_a/2). The spec's rendering is therefore faithful to pymupdf and its provenance label is CORRECT; only the auxiliary .txt extraction drops the glyphs. This entry was registered as provenance-label-wrong on the strength of the .txt alone -- a misreading. The erratum is to THIS registry entry, not to formula-spec.md; no edit to the spec is warranted for this item. Generalisable lesson: a .txt extraction cannot adjudicate a claim that is labelled as coming from a different extractor.
